name: 13681-varlen-olmo3-7b-1gpu
model: allenai/Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, ungated, served in its native bf16.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: Olmo3ForCausalLM, 7.3B dense bf16, 32 layers, hidden 4096, 32 query heads over 32 key/value heads at head_dim 128, sliding_window 4096, max_position_embeddings 65536.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=24, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 512 requests with a 1200 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix buckets, seed 42. Prompts ~2048 tokens over [128, 4096] (stdev 1182), generations ~512 tokens over [32, 1024] (stdev 296), temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true so every request generates its full sampled length. Radix cache left at its default.
purpose: A 7B instruct assistant drafting long-form replies to varied single-turn prompts for 24 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser and the engine then runs
# without something this file declares.

model-path: allenai/Olmo-3-7B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
mem-fraction-static: 0.8

# Do not substitute flashinfer: the engine asserts against it for this architecture and will not start.
attention-backend: fa3
